stock.description: Transmit Entertainment Limited functions as a diversified investment holding company, operating across the media and entertainment sectors in Hong Kong, Macau, mainland China, and globally. The company structures its operations into three main divisions: the production, distribution, and licensing of films and television series; film exhibition; and a pan-entertainment segment. Its core business involves producing Chinese movies and TV shows, alongside managing a cinema located in Hong Kong. Additionally, the company engages in e-commerce and offers services in advertising, marketing, and publishing. Transmit Entertainment further provides specialized services such as film promotion, management for cinema operations, screenwriters, performing artists, and directors, as well as support for internet celebrities. Established in 2009, the company's headquarters are in Wan Chai, Hong Kong. It was formerly known as Pegasus Entertainment Holdings Limited before rebranding to Transmit Entertainment Limited in February 2018, and it operates as a subsidiary of Nice Rich Group Limited.
